rows.note: Use 一跳 as the all-purpose noun for one short jump; use 單腳跳 when one leg is specified.

example.english: They clear the ditch in one hop.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 tiu3 zau6 tiu3 gwo3 tiu4 haang1

rows.note: Use this everyday term for the hop plant or its flowers used in brewing beer.

example.english: This beer has lots of hop flowers in it, so it tastes really fragrant.
example.traditional: 呢款啤酒加咗好多啤酒花，飲落好香。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 be1 zau2 gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1 be1 zau2 faa1 jam2 lok6 hou2 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this when the jump is specifically made on one leg.

example.english: They hop across the playground on one leg.
example.traditional: 佢哋用單腳跳過個操場。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 daan1 goek3 tiu3 gwo3 go3 cou1 coeng4

rows.note: Use this for the short air-travel sense, especially a short flight in a private plane.

example.english: We took a private plane to the outlying island; the whole trip was just a short hop.
example.traditional: 我哋搭私人飛機去離島，成程只係短途飛行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 si1 jan4 fei1 gei1 heoi3 lei4 dou2 seng4 cing4 zi2 hai6 dyun2 tou4 fei1 hang4
